plan: Drive: from Mica Creek, about 47 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.9707, -119.0939, pull off on Finn-Tum FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: none. The spot is at the road.
Hunt: ducks, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).

Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-42, Region 3. Season: ducks Sept 8 to Dec 23, 8 a day, 24 in possession and more rows (federal Migratory Birds Regulations, 99%). 1 legal flag below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-10, closures 2026-10-16.

Hunt: moose, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
